ModuleName: Common Actions: Running Multiple Tasks for a Single Module Together

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: This JSON file defines the topic outline for the module, listing the sections and bullet-point subtopics that structure the learning content on the Common Actions Hub, and serves as the navigational blueprint for the module's lessons.

Artifacts.Name: Introduction to the Common Actions Hub
Artifacts.Description: This lesson introduces the Common Actions Hub, explaining what it is, why it exists, and how it fits into the instructor's workflow as a centralized place to manage the generation of multiple course assets for a module.

Artifacts.Name: Selecting and Configuring Generation Tasks
Artifacts.Description: This lesson walks instructors through how to access the Common Actions Hub, understand the available generation task types, and choose and configure which tasks to include before running them.

Artifacts.Name: Running Multiple Tasks Together in One Step
Artifacts.Description: This lesson explains how instructors can trigger the generation of multiple course assets — such as documents, quizzes, and slide decks — simultaneously through a single coordinated action in the Common Actions Hub, rather than producing each output separately.

Artifacts.Name: Persistent Settings Per Course
Artifacts.Description: This lesson covers how the Common Actions Hub saves an instructor's task selections and configuration settings on a per-course basis, so that preferences are remembered across sessions rather than needing to be re-entered each time.

Artifacts.Name: Per-Topic Quiz Generation and Reliability
Artifacts.Description: This lesson explains why PreseMaker generates quizzes on a per-topic basis rather than across an entire module at once, describing how this granular approach improves quiz quality, relevance, and reliability.

Artifacts.Name: Per-Topic Quiz Generation and Reliability
